title: An agent's snapshot
description: What agent.read answers: what the agent or conversation is doing now, and where its log stands. Read and follow the log after cursor.

description.description: What the agent is for, from its definition.

model.description: The model it runs on, from its definition or the deployment's default.

status.description: Whether it waits for a message, answers one, waits on a person, sleeps until something asks it, or can't start because its saved state can't be read.

problem.description: Why its saved state can't be read while status is unreadable, such as a module it names that this release doesn't have. agent.define starts it over.

node.description: The node it runs on, by its name; null while it sleeps.

interrupts.description: The calls it waits on a person for.

cursor.description: Where its log stands, as events.list and agent.events take it.

next_run.description: When the next of its triggers on a clock runs; null where none does.

reset.description: What agent.define started over because its saved state couldn't be read, and why. Only agent.define answers it.
